PART--I-- Orders and Notifications by the Government of Tripura, The High Court, Government Treasury etc. GOVERNMENT OF TRIPURA OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT MAGISTRATE & COLLECTOR WEST TRIPURA DISTRICT No.F. 4 (11)/DM/W/JDL/Vol-IV/2013/390-08 Dated 02/03/2019 WHEREAS, information has been received from the S.P.(DIB), West Tripura vide letter No.7230/SP/DIB/W/2019 dated-26/02/2019 that the H.S(+2 stage) and Madhyamik Examination-2019 conducted by the T.B.S.E in different venues of the West Tripura District are going to be started on from 01/03/2019 and shall continue till 03/04/2019. AND WHEREAS, it is apprehended that organization of such meeting, processions, public gathering etc. with use of Crackers and loud speaker in the schedule below will hamper peace and wellbeing of the examines and such processions, public gathering of 5 or more persons, carrying of lethal weapons and use Crackers, loud speaker etc. within the said are required to be prohibited under West Tripura District. WHEREAS, I, Dr. Sandeep Mahatme, IAS, District Magistrate & Collector, West Tripura District, am satisficd that there are sufficient grounds for imposing restriction on organizing processions, public gathering of S or more persons carrying of lethal weapons and use of Crackers and loud speaker etc. within the said in the area shown in the schedule below. NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of powers conferred upon me U/S- 144 of Cr.P.C1973 I, Dr. Sandeep Mahatme, IAS, District Magistrate & Collector, West Tripura District, Agartala hereby prohibit conducting of any procession, public gathering of 5 or more persons, carrying of lethal weapons and use Crackers, use of loud

speaker etc. in the schedule below by any organization(a) people. SCHEDULE. Within the 200 yards radius of each examination Centers as per enclosed list under West Tripura District. In view of the emergent nature of situation and with a view to ensure public peace and tranquility, this order is passed exparte. Any person violating order shall be liable to be prosecuted U/S-188 IPC. 7 Given under my seal and signature, this day OAast _ Manele. 2019 pos (Dr. AF rect, LAS) Distri Magistrate & Collector, West Tripura District. Tripura Gazette, Extraordinary Issue, March 5, 2019 A.D.
